definitions.explanation: Having a negative outlook on life or situations, expecting unfavorable outcomes.

examples.japanese: {悲観的|ひかんてき}にならないでください。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{物事|ものごと}を{悲観的|ひかんてき}に{見|み}る{傾向|けいこう}がある。
examples.english: She tends to see things pessimistically.

examples.japanese: {経済|けいざい}の{先行|せんこう}きに{悲観的|ひかんてき}な{予測|よそく}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: There are many pessimistic forecasts about the economic outlook.

notes:
FORMS:
・Adverbial: {悲観的|ひかんてき}に (pessimistically)
・Noun: {悲観|ひかん} (pessimism)
・Verb: {悲観|ひかん}する (to be pessimistic)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{悲観的|ひかんてき}な{見方|みかた}/{考|かんが}え (pessimistic view/thinking)
・{悲観的|ひかんてき}に{考|かんが}える (think pessimistically)
・{悲観的|ひかんてき}な{予測|よそく} (pessimistic forecast)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・ネガティブ (negative) - more casual, loanword
・{後|うし}ろ{向|む}き (backward-looking) - emphasizes reluctant attitude
